user.title: Schedule and audit log
user.description: LessRecords starts in simulation mode and never deletes data during setup. Choose a daily local time away from Recorder's nightly maintenance (around 04:12). Keep Recorder auto_purge enabled and set its purge_keep_days to at least your longest label retention.

data.run_time: Daily purge time (Home Assistant local time)
data.audit_log: Write to a dedicated rotating audit log (recommended)

label.title: Add a label retention policy
label.description: Select a label applied directly to entities and a retention period in whole days (1–3650). Add further labels as needed. If several labels match, the longest retention wins.

warning.title: Review data-loss and Recorder warnings
warning.description: **Important:** Recorder purging is irreversible. Make a verified backup first. Home Assistant's independent global purge still affects all entities, including those without LessRecords labels. Long-term statistics are outside LessRecords scope. Neither simulation nor the Recorder purge action guarantees immediate disk space recovery. The initial installation always runs in simulation mode; destructive purging requires a second preview and explicit activation in integration options.

data.acknowledge: I have read and understood these warnings

error.invalid_retention: Retention must be a whole number of days between 1 and 3650.
error.duplicate_label: This label already has a retention policy.
error.unknown_label: The selected label does not exist.
error.acknowledgement_required: You must explicitly acknowledge the warnings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one LessRecords configuration is supported.

menu_options.settings: Global purge schedule and audit logging

settings.title: Daily schedule and audit logging
settings.description: All purge devices share this single daily local time. The audit log is visible from the LessRecords Audit log entity and downloadable in integration Diagnostics. Disabling the dedicated file uses the standard Home Assistant log only.

policy_warning.title: Confirm change to retention policy
policy_warning.description: **Pending change:** {change}. Saving the change will switch LessRecords to simulation mode and revoke live purge approval. This prevents any unexpected deletion. After checking the simulated scope, explicitly activate live purging again in the options.

data.acknowledge: I understand the change and want to apply it

activate.title: Preview scope and activate irreversible purge requests
activate.description: **Destructive operation.** Targets: **{target_count}**. Retention groups: **{retention_groups}**. Entity IDs (truncated): {targets}. Create a verified backup. Acknowledging enables permission for live purging but per-label Simulation mode switches remain ON initially. Disable a label's Simulation mode on its purge device to opt that label into live deletion. Overlapping entities remain protected if any matching label is simulated. Enabling 'Preserve historical boundary state' creates synthetic backdated Recorder rows from the nearest preceding historical state. This is experimental and can misrepresent data, especially counters, unavailable values and statistics. It requires a new approval after enabling. Global Recorder purge still runs independently. An accepted purge request is not proof of completed deletion.

data.acknowledge: I have reviewed this scope, verified my backup, and explicitly authorize irreversible deletion

policies.title: Manage label retention policies
policies.description: Current label → retention rules: {policies}. Edit a saved value, add a label, or remove one without replacing the other rules.

edit_policy.title: Choose the policy to edit
edit_policy.description: Select an existing label. The dropdown includes its currently saved retention period.

edit_retention.title: Edit retention for {label_name}
edit_retention.description: Current retention: **{current_days} days**. The stored value is prefilled; change only the number of days. Other labels will not be modified.

add_policy.title: Add a label retention policy
add_policy.description: Choose a new label and a retention period (1–3650 whole days). All existing label policies are preserved.

remove_policy.title: Remove an existing label policy
remove_policy.description: Select the label whose LessRecords policy should be removed. Other policies remain unchanged. At least one label must remain configured.

error.invalid_retention: Retention must be between 1 and 3650 whole days.
error.unknown_label: The selected label does not exist.
error.scope_changed: The entity scope changed during review. Reopen the activation screen to review it again.

abort.invalid_policies: The current retention policies are invalid. No changes were saved.
abort.policies_changed: The saved policies changed during this operation. Reopen the options and review the latest values.
abort.last_policy_required: At least one label retention policy must remain configured. Add another label before removing this one.
